Ka(kā)śyapa
dh. Q. in Govindārṇava, Saṁskāra,
, p.. 25b. 59b ff.; Prāyaścitta, ibid. p.. 46b. 118b. 126b; in Smṛtiratna of Mādhava,

. p.. 122. 316. 376. 383; often in Vīramitrodaya, Saṁskāra an. Śrāddha, Chowkhamba edn. For some other q.s an. ref.s, see IO. i. p.. 100b, 413b; ii. p. 445b.
See under Kāśyapa.

Ka(kā_?)śyapapaṭala
dh. Q. in Jyotirnibandha of Śivadāsa, Ānandāśrama edn. (1919) p. 159 ff.; in Paraśurāmapratāpa, Saṁskārakāṇḍa (
of Viś. (i). fol. 104b; see Poona Ori. VII. p. 13); in Nārāyaṇa's C. on his own Muhūrtamārtaṇḍa, see Bhāratīya Jyotiṣa, Hindi edn. p. 622.
